text: The World Bank Group’s Disaster Risk Financing and Insurance Program (DRFI/DRFIP) aims to provide financial protection strategies to governments, helping them manage fiscal and economic risks from natural hazards and climate-related shocks. The program supports the design and implementation of comprehensive financial protection strategies, integrating sovereign disaster risk financing, agricultural insurance, property catastrophe risk insurance, and scalable social protection. It leverages partnerships with international organizations and private market actors to enhance financial resilience, particularly in China through the ASEAN+3 regional collaboration.
